item.title: A new Chief of Staff
item.description: Stephen Miller becomes Chief of Staff on Monday; Susie Wiles moves to the political operation, with thanks.

item.title: Nobody wants to say that
item.description: Without him, the President writes, Israel and the entire Middle East would not exist today. Nobody wants to say it; everybody knows it.

item.title: Joe will never let you down
item.description: A Complete and Total Endorsement for the RNC Chairman, who once named the President Statesman of the Year. Twice.

item.title: Super Intelligence is GOLD
item.description: The President is 100% in favour of Super Intelligence, and of the states that get rich from it. Those that say no are foolish. A real president, and five regions, reply.

item.title: Newsmax says so
item.description: Early morning: the President shares a headline that calls him a winner. A real president would have let it go.
